Sector 02 · Freight, cargo & supply chain

Logistics That Connects Business

Coordinated logistics supporting the movement of goods across commercial and international supply chains.

Discuss a Shipment → View Categories

The approach

A shipment is only as good as the coordination behind it. We work across freight, transport, customs and warehousing partners to keep cargo moving on an agreed plan — and to tell you early when that plan needs to change.

Industrial supplyProject cargoRetail and wholesale goodsEquipment movement

What this desk covers

Freight Coordination

Sea, road and air freight arranged against the commercial terms of the order.

Cargo Coordination

Consolidation, documentation and handover between carriers.

Transportation

Inland movement to site, yard, warehouse or port.

Warehousing Coordination

Short and longer-term storage arranged with warehouse partners.

Import & Export Coordination

Coordination of customs formalities and clearance requirements.

Supply Chain Support

Planning support where several suppliers feed one delivery programme.

Regional Distribution

Onward distribution across Oman and neighbouring markets.

Delivery Coordination

Scheduled delivery windows and confirmed receipt at destination.

The chain

Seven stages, one point of contact

Select a stage to see what we handle at that point.

Supplier

Qualified sources are confirmed against the requirement, with production or dispatch dates put in writing.

Sourcing

Commercial terms, packing and documentation requirements are agreed before anything moves.

Transportation

Mode and routing are selected on cost, transit time and the nature of the cargo.

Customs

Import and export formalities are coordinated with clearing agents so paperwork precedes the cargo.

Warehousing

Storage is arranged where the delivery window and the arrival date do not match.

Distribution

Consignments are split, consolidated or staged for onward regional movement.

Customer

Delivery is scheduled to the receiving point, confirmed and closed out with documentation.

Housewares Trade

Connecting quality household and hospitality products with commercial buyers across regional markets.

Request Product Information → View Categories

The approach

Volume buyers judge housewares on three things: consistency between shipments, honest specification, and a landed price that holds. We source against those criteria for retailers, wholesalers, hospitality operators and facility suppliers.

RetailWholesale distributionHotels and hospitalityFacility management
